_note: Interests & integrity (interests-and-integrity) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). MyDeclarations self-service page + Nevenfuncties/NevenfunctieDetail + Geschenken/GeschenkDetail index/detail pages; schema refs BY SLUG (nevenfunctie / geschenk), never PascalCase. Stable-name contract for member-onboarding: capability interests-and-integrity, slug nevenfunctie, page id MyDeclarations. The Dashboard 'Nevenfuncties zonder actuele review' stat widget and the per-body compliance panel on the Nevenfuncties index (REQ-INT-010) are frontend/base-manifest work (Task 5) and are NOT part of this declarative-core fragment: mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so the Dashboard widget lives in the base src/manifest.json. MyDeclarations here is the declarative index shell over the member's own nevenfuncties; the member's own declarations and their actions are the MyDeclarationsPanel slot, and publish/withdraw are header actions on the two detail pages (Task 4).

pages.title: My declarations
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-25-interests-and-integrity/specs/interests-and-integrity/spec.md#requirement-req-int-010. Self-service page (REQ-INT-010) — stable deep-link target for member-onboarding's nevenfuncties-intake step. Declarative index shell over the current user's own nevenfuncties; The MyDeclarationsPanel slot lists the member's own positions and gifts and carries the declare, register-gift, end-position and annual-confirm actions, each a plain saveObject of the whole object (Task 4). Members see and edit only their own objects via OR per-object RBAC (owner scope).

config._note: Current-user filtering (own declarations only) is applied client-side / via OR owner-scoped RBAC; the manifest cannot express a 'current user' filter token declaratively.

pages.title: Other positions
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-25-interests-and-integrity/specs/interests-and-integrity/spec.md#requirement-req-int-010. Per-body nevenfunctiesregister (REQ-INT-001/REQ-INT-010). Columns person/organisatie/functie/remunerated/qualitateQua/governanceBody/lifecycle; quick filters on lifecycle; per-body filtering via the index facet on governanceBody. CSV export via ExportService + CnMassExportDialog. The overdue-review KPI deep-link (Dashboard, base manifest) targets this page pre-filtered; the per-body compliance panel (client-side join of memberships × nevenfuncties, AncillaryCompliancePanel) renders in the below-header slot.

pages.title: Other position
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-25-interests-and-integrity/specs/interests-and-integrity/spec.md#requirement-req-int-001. Nevenfunctie detail. Declaration data leads 8-wide, publication stacked right; the linked person/governanceBody render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets. Publish/withdraw are header actions that PATCH publicationDate/depublicationDate on the live object (REQ-INT-004); update is staff-only in the schema, so the server refuses anyone else. End-position and annual-confirm live on MyDeclarations (Task 4). Audit trail is a sidebar tab.
